title: APG tree, every key
text: Arrows, Home, End, type-ahead, and * to expand siblings, with one tab stop and RTL-aware arrows.

title: Lazy children
text: An async hook loads children on first expansion, with a busy state, an error message, and retry.

title: Tri-state checkboxes
text: Checking a parent checks its descendants; partly checked parents show the mixed state.

title: Move by drag or keyboard
text: Drag to reorder or reparent, or cut and paste with Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V; every move is cancelable.

title: Rename and filter
text: F2 renames in a text input; a filter keeps the paths to matches visible and highlights them.

title: 10,000+ visible nodes
text: Rows are virtualized on the shared windowing engine; the focused node always stays rendered.
